comments.text: Karen Trevino still has an obligation to pay the company that she had hired for their services. The work was still done. Allegedly snitching to ICE doesn't help her avoid what she agrees to and owes. And I read about some rumored charges she may face because of her actions. An individual's actions like she was accused of would be similar to trafficking, threatening/trying to get free labor because she could call ICE on the workers. But this is on brand for what Don was doing with his companies leading up to his bankruptcies.. I work in immigration and was once a federal employee with USCIS. There were people who would come in often with interests in contacting ICE on someone, usually a person they knew and were angry with.. What trips me out is how people are not aware, do not care, have no concern of what it took for someone to leave their home country, often times, their entire families to try to make a living in a country like the US, taking the jobs many Americans do not want, with the threat of being fired at any moment, deported whenever the employer or someone who doesn't like them feels like contacting ICE, accepting the lower wage and no labor protections.. If the current war led to the US Citizens having to relocate to unfamiliar lands, should citizens in the other countries turn their backs on Americans because it's not their problem? Should they immediately refuse to assist and say their borders are closed? What exactly would Americans do if we had to suddenly be uprooted with barely anything on us but the clothes we are wearing? Who could we say would offer a safe haven, especially after what the current "president" has said and done over the years?
